legalPrivacy.title: Privacy Policy
legalPrivacy.intro: PetNet ("we", "our", "us") operates a directory and booking platform for pet-related businesses in Mongolia. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.
legalPrivacy.disclaimer: This is a plain-language summary of how PetNet handles your data. As the platform grows we recommend having this policy reviewed by a qualified lawyer to ensure full compliance with Mongolian data protection law.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and phone number. When you add a pet profile, we collect the information you choose to provide about your pet — name, species, breed, and date of birth. When you book a service, we share your name, phone number and pet details with the business you're booking so they can prepare for your appointment. We also automatically collect basic usage data (pages viewed, searches made, device and browser type) to keep PetNet working reliably.

sections.heading: How we use your information
sections.body: We use your information to create and secure your account, to connect you with businesses when you book a service, to send you booking confirmations and updates, and to improve search and recommendations. We do not sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: What we share, and with whom
sections.body: We share the minimum information a business needs to fulfill a booking you make with them — typically your name, phone number and the pet you're booking for. We don't share your data with other businesses, advertisers, or data brokers.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: We keep your account and booking history for as long as your account is active, so you can look back at past appointments. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You can view and edit your account and pet information at any time from your account settings. You can request a copy of your data, or ask us to delete it, by writing to hello@petnet.mn.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use essential cookies to keep you signed in, and local browser storage to remember things like your saved searches and favorite places. We don't use third-party advertising trackers.

sections.heading: Children's privacy
sections.body: PetNet is intended for users 16 years of age or older. We don't knowingly collect information from children under 16.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: As PetNet grows, this policy will grow with it. We'll update the date at the top of this page whenever we make a meaningful change, and for significant changes we'll let registered users know directly.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: Questions about this policy? Write to us at hello@petnet.mn.

legalTerms.title: Terms of Service
legalTerms.intro: These terms govern your use of PetNet. By creating an account or using the site, you agree to them.
legalTerms.disclaimer: This is a foundational, plain-language set of terms. As the platform grows we recommend having them reviewed by a qualified lawyer.

sections.heading: Using PetNet
sections.body: PetNet helps you discover pet-related businesses in Ulaanbaatar and request appointments with them. You must be at least 16 years old to create an account. You're responsible for keeping your account credentials secure.

sections.heading: Bookings and appointments
sections.body: When you request a booking through PetNet, you're sending an appointment request to that business — the business confirms availability and service directly. Cancellation and rescheduling policies are shown at the time of booking; please respect the stated notice window out of courtesy to the business.

sections.heading: Business listings
sections.body: Business information (hours, prices, services) is provided by or on behalf of each business and may change without notice. Always confirm details that matter to you — like emergency availability — directly with the business.

sections.heading: Content and conduct
sections.body: Reviews and any content you post must be honest, based on a real experience, and free of harassment, hate speech, or spam. We may remove content that violates these terms.

sections.heading: No warranty
sections.body: PetNet is provided "as is." We work to keep listings accurate and the booking flow reliable, but we don't guarantee that any business will be available, or that information is error-free.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: PetNet is a platform connecting pet owners and businesses — we are not a party to the services a business provides. To the fullest extent permitted by law, PetNet isn't liable for the quality, safety, or outcome of services booked through the platform.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms as PetNet grows. Continued use of the platform after a change means you accept the updated terms.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of Mongolia.

sections.heading: Contact us
sections.body: Questions about these terms? Write to us at hello@petnet.mn.

aboutPage.title: About PetNet
aboutPage.lead: PetNet started with a simple problem: finding a trustworthy vet, groomer, or pet hotel in Ulaanbaatar meant asking around in Facebook groups and hoping for the best. We're building the map that should have existed already.
aboutPage.todayBody: Search and filter pet businesses across Ulaanbaatar's districts — vets, groomers, shops, hotels, trainers, parks, shelters and breeders — on an interactive map. Compare hours, prices, amenities and real reviews, then request an appointment directly from a business's page.
aboutPage.nextBody: Pet profiles with health tracking, a community for pet owners, adoption listings, and tools for businesses to manage their own bookings are all on the roadmap. We're building them one at a time, so what's live is always real, not a placeholder.
aboutPage.teamBody: PetNet is a Mongolia-based team building for the Mongolian pet-owner community first.

contactPage.title: Contact us
contactPage.intro: Have a question, found a bug, or want to list your business on PetNet? We'd like to hear from you.
